title: Innovation Lessons for Product Managers: Balancing the Here and Now and the Future
content:
Balancing the here and now with what the future can offer is one of the most persistent tensions in product management. This conversation with Andrea from Applause explores strategies that enable product managers to stay forward-thinking while still delivering on today's commitments.

Key themes

  • Why the pressure to ship often kills the space for innovation — and how to protect both
  • Practical frameworks for allocating attention between near-term delivery and future exploration
  • How to build a culture within your team that values both execution and discovery
  • The role of curiosity as a professional discipline, not just a personality trait

The core challenge

Most product managers are measured primarily on what they deliver today. Yet the most impactful contributions often come from the work done months or years before — in defining the right problems, exploring emerging opportunities, and shaping the product direction. The question isn't whether to do both, but how.

About this piece

A conversation between Remko Vermeulen and Andrea from Applause.
